description: This file contains functions and classes related to dispatching and managing ACP (Agent Control Protocol) replies, including session management, media handling, error processing, and reply lifecycle coordination.

methods.name: resolveFirstContextText
methods.description: Returns the first string value found in the context for the given keys.

methods.name: resolveAcpPromptText
methods.description: Extracts and trims the prompt text from the message context.

methods.name: resolveAcpAttachments
methods.description: Normalizes attachments, fetches image attachments as base64 buffers, and returns them.

methods.name: resolveCommandCandidateText
methods.description: Extracts and trims the command candidate text from the message context.

methods.name: shouldBypassAcpDispatchForCommand
methods.description: Determines if dispatch should be bypassed based on command content and permissions.

methods.name: resolveAcpRequestId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a request ID based on message context.

methods.name: hasBoundConversationForSession
methods.description: Checks if there is an existing bound conversation for the session with specific channel and account ID.

methods.name: resolveDispatchAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID to use for dispatch based on configuration and raw input.

methods.name: isStaleSessionInitError
methods.description: Checks if an error code and message indicate a stale session initialization.

methods.name: maybeUnbindStaleBoundConversations
methods.description: Unbinds stale session bindings if detected.

methods.name: finalizeAcpTurnOutput
methods.description: Finalizes the reply turn, including TTS, media, and session identity notices.

methods.name: tryDispatchAcpReply
methods.description: Main function to handle dispatching an ACP reply, managing session resolution, media, errors, and lifecycle.
